title: Exhaustion of an open convex set by convex inner parallel sets with margins
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every open convex U ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) there are sets O_j ⊆ ℝⁿ and reals σ_j (j ∈ ℕ) such that: j ↦ O_j is increasing (Monotone); ⋃_j O_j = U; σ_j → 0; and for every j, O_j is open and convex, σ_j > 0, and the closed ball closedBall(x, σ_j) ⊆ U for every x ∈ O_j.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → Convex ℝ U → ∃ (O : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (σ : ℕ → ℝ), Monotone O ∧ ⋃ j, O j = U ∧ Tendsto σ atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ j, IsOpen (O j) ∧ Convex ℝ (O j) ∧ 0 < σ j ∧ ∀ x ∈ O j, closedBall x (σ j) ⊆ U
